items.title: Open-SWE-Traces: Advancing Dual-Mode Multilingual Distillation for Software Engineering Agents
items.title_zh: Open-SWE-Traces：推进软件工程 Agent 的双模式多语言蒸馏
items.summary: Open-SWE-Traces is a dataset of 207,489 agentic software-engineering trajectories spanning nine programming languages, sourced from 20,000 real-world pull requests through OpenHands and SWE-agent harnesses. Fine-tuning Qwen3-30B-A3B on it reaches 61.7% on SWE-bench Verified, 57.1% on SWE-bench Multilingual, and 36.8% on SWE-bench Pro.

items.title: $τ$-Rec: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Recommender Systems
items.title_zh: τ-Rec：面向 Agent 推荐系统的可验证基准
items.summary: $\tau$-Rec replaces subjective LLM-as-a-judge evaluation for agentic recommenders with verifiable rewards and a reveal-tagged elicitation mechanism that controls when task constraints surface during dialogue. Across nine configurations from five model families, even the best model reaches only about 57% at pass^1 and 35% at pass^4, revealing a steep reliability cliff.

items.title: EEVEE: Towards Test-time Prompt Learning in the Real World for Self-Improving Agents
items.title_zh: EEVEE：面向自改进 Agent 的真实世界测试时提示学习
items.summary: EEVEE is a multi-dataset test-time prompt learning framework that routes heterogeneous inputs into task clusters and co-evolves the router with prompt configurations. It improves average multi-benchmark scores by 10.38 and 24.32 points over Qwen3-4B-Instruct and DeepSeek-V3.2, and reportedly surpasses SOTA methods GEPA and ACE by up to 37.2% and 48.2%.

items.title: OpenAI to acquire Ona
items.title_zh: OpenAI 将收购 Ona
items.summary: OpenAI says it plans to acquire Ona to expand Codex with secure, persistent cloud environments that support long-running AI agents across enterprise workflows.

items.title: APEX: Adaptive Principle EXtraction A Three-Layer Self-Evolution Framework for Production AI Agents
items.title_zh: APEX：面向生产级 AI Agent 的三层自适应原则提取自演化框架
items.summary: APEX is a three-layer co-evolution framework that simultaneously patches an agent harness from failure modes, distills behavioural principles from success traces, and selects workflow topology by structural fitness. On a production agent managing a 15-node fleet, it reports an APEX Health Score of 0.570, up 90% from a 0.300 baseline, using four LLM calls on a local qwen2.5-coder:32b instance.

items.title_zh: APEX：面向生产级 AI Agent 的三层自适应原则提取自演化框架
items.summary: APEX is a three-layer co-evolution framework that simultaneously patches an agent harness from failure modes, distills behavioural principles from success traces, and selects workflow topology by structural fitness. items.title: ReasonRec: A Reasoning-Augmented Multimodal Agent for Unified Recommendation
items.title_zh: ReasonRec：面向统一推荐的理由增强多模态 Agent
items.summary: ReasonRec is a reasoning-augmented multimodal recommendation agent built around a three-stage explicit reasoning pipeline, with reasoning-aware visual instruction tuning that turns recommendation tasks into unified chain-of-thought prompts and uncertainty-guided delegation of compute. Across four recommendation tasks and five real-world datasets it reports over 30% relative improvement and better cold-start and long-tail handling.

items.title: ABC-Bench: An Agentic Bio-Capabilities Benchmark for Biosecurity
items.title_zh: ABC-Bench：面向生物安全的 Agent 生物能力基准
items.summary: ABC-Bench measures agentic biosecurity-relevant capabilities on both benign and dual-use tasks: writing code for liquid-handling robots, designing DNA fragments for in vitro assembly, and evading DNA synthesis screening. All tested LLM agents outperformed the median expert human baseliner on all three, and in wet-lab validation OpenAI's o4-mini-high produced scripts that assembled DNA with expected sequences on an OpenTrons robot.

items.title: ProcAgent: An Agentic Framework for Procedural Task Guidance on Edge with Human-in-the-Loop
items.title_zh: ProcAgent：边缘端人在回路的过程性任务指导 Agent 框架
items.summary: ProcAgent is a fully on-device procedural assistant on a single NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, combining continuous perception, a symbolic task graph, on-demand vision-language verification, and an LLM interaction agent in a propose-and-verify design. It resolves text-only queries in about 2 seconds and visually grounded queries in about 8 seconds, and drew positive ratings for comprehensibility, actionability, and privacy comfort from 10 assembly-study participants.

items.title: Constrained Semantic Decompression in LLMs through Persian Proverb-Conditioned Story Generation
items.title_zh: 通过波斯谚语条件故事生成研究 LLM 的受约束语义解压
items.summary: The paper frames proverb-conditioned story generation as constrained semantic decompression and introduces PAND, a Persian dataset pairing proverbs with human-written stories and explicit meanings. It finds a persistent decompression gap: models often produce fluent narratives that fail to faithfully instantiate the underlying moral and causal structure, though explicit reasoning and iterative refinement partially mitigate these failures.

items.title: Keep Policy Gradient in Charge: Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
items.title_zh: 让策略梯度掌舵：面向长程工具使用 Agent 的兄弟引导信用蒸馏
items.summary: Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation uses distillation for bounded credit weighting rather than as a competing actor loss: mixed sibling rollouts are summarized by an external LLM into a training-only credit reference that reshapes GRPO token advantages. It reports higher held-out point estimates than GRPO-family comparators, with AppWorld TGC rising from 42.9 to 45.6 on test_normal and the tau^3-airline evaluator score from 0.583 to 0.602.

items.title: Rethinking Psychometric Evaluation of LLMs: When and Why Self-Reports Predict Behavior
items.title_zh: 重新思考 LLM 的心理测量评估：自我报告何时以及为何能预测行为
items.summary: A study across four behavioral tasks and 11 frontier LLMs finds that self-reports predict behavior only selectively: the Theory of Planned Behavior reaches human-level coherence within a shared conversation while the Big 5 does not, and coherence across separate conversations holds only for behaviors anchored outside the immediate prompt.

items.title: Hallucination as a Feature, not a Defect: Evaluating a multi-agent architecture to transform speculative language-model outputs into testable scientific hypotheses
items.title_zh: 幻觉是特性而非缺陷：用多 Agent 架构将推测性模型输出转化为可检验科学假设
items.summary: The paper proposes a Rust-based multi-agent orchestration that pairs a high-entropy generating agent with a web-grounded evaluating agent through a low-entropy semantic bottleneck, aiming to turn speculative model outputs into viability-rated scientific hypotheses. It reports that direct prompting was among the weakest conditions, but the full system did not generally outperform simple self-reflection.

items.title: Recursive Agent Harnesses
items.title_zh: 递归 Agent Harness：以完整 Agent 框架为递归单元
items.summary: Recursive Agent Harnesses (RAH) extends recursion over model calls to recursion over full agent harnesses: a parent agent runs a script that spawns subagent harnesses with filesystem tools, code execution, and planning. With GPT-5 held fixed, RAH raises a Codex coding-agent baseline from 71.75% to 81.36% on Oolong-Synthetic, and reaches 89.77% with Claude Sonnet 4.5.

items.title: MVEB: Massive Video Embedding Benchmark
items.title_zh: MVEB：大规模视频嵌入基准
items.summary: MVEB is a 23-task benchmark for video embeddings covering classification, clustering, pair classification, retrieval, and video-centric question answering, evaluated across 33 models. No single model dominates: MLLM-based embeddings lead several task types, multimodal binding leads retrieval and zero-shot classification, and audio's contribution depends on whether dataset labels were produced from both modalities.

items.title: Encode Errors: Representational Retrieval of In-Context Demonstrations for Multilingual Grammatical Error Correction
items.title_zh: 编码错误：面向多语言语法纠错的情境示例表征检索
items.summary: The paper extracts a Grammatical Error Representation from LLM internal states and uses it to retrieve in-context demonstrations that match error patterns rather than surface semantics. GER-based retrieval improves multilingual grammatical error correction, with 8B open models matching Deepseek2.5 and GPT-4o-mini on high-resource languages and low-resource F0.5 scores rising by up to a factor of 1.20 over baseline.

items.title: BALTO: Balanced Token-Level Policy Optimization for Hallucination Mitigation
items.title_zh: BALTO：面向幻觉缓解的平衡 token 级策略优化
items.summary: BALTO extracts checkable factual claims, verifies them against the reference context, and projects claim-level judgments onto token-level labels with a balanced credit-assignment mechanism. It reports the highest faithfulness across all six model-benchmark settings on ConFiQA, RAGTruth, and FinLLM-Eval, with better faithfulness-informativeness trade-offs than existing post-training baselines.

items.title: From Argument Components to Graphs: A Multi-Agent Debate with Confidence Gating for Argument Relations
items.title_zh: 从论辩成分到关系图：带置信度门控的多 Agent 辩论
items.summary: The authors apply a Proponent-Opponent-Judge multi-agent debate to argument relation identification and add confidence gating so that only uncertain cases are debated. On UKP Argument Annotated Essays v2, the selective version posts the best Macro F1 among training-free methods, while debating every sample performs worse than one baseline.

items.title: Specific Domain Ontology Construction Using Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 使用大语言模型构建特定领域本体
items.summary: The authors had GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 act as domain experts to build twenty ontologies for Brazil's maritime territory; human experts found the results broadly coherent but not fully satisfactory without refinement.

items.title: A Source Domain is All You Need: Source-Only Cross-OS Transfer Learning for APT Anomaly Detection via Semantic Alignment and Optimal Transport
items.title_zh: 仅需源域：通过语义对齐与最优传输实现跨 OS APT 异常检测
items.summary: The paper studies source-only cross-OS APT detection from system-level provenance traces, abstracting process behavior into structured natural-language descriptions and embedding them for comparison against a source-normal reference. It combines semantic, structural (graph-autoencoder), and optimal-transport deviations into a barycentric anomaly score, requiring no target-domain labels.

items.title: XMedFusion: A Knowledge-Guided Multimodal Perception and Reasoning Framework for Autonomous Medical Systems
items.title_zh: XMedFusion：面向自主医疗系统的知识引导多模态感知与推理框架
items.summary: XMedFusion decomposes radiology report generation into a visual perception agent, a knowledge-graph construction agent, retrieval-guided drafting, and a synthesis agent that reasons over integrated evidence. On a public chest radiograph dataset it reports BLEU-1 gains from 0.0493 to 0.3359 and ROUGE-L from 0.0863 to 0.2440 over baseline vision-language models.

items.title: The Periodic Table of LLM Reasoning: A Structured Survey of Reasoning Paradigms, Methods, and Failure Modes
items.title_zh: LLM 推理的周期表：推理范式、方法与失效模式的结构化综述
items.summary: This survey organizes 300+ recent papers into a "Periodic Table of LLM Reasoning" spanning nine paradigms, from chain-of-thought and multi-hop reasoning to retrieval-augmented, tool-augmented or agentic, and reinforcement-learning-based reasoning. It reviews methods, benchmarks, and recurring failure modes, arguing that reasoning is not one emergent capability but a family of scaffolded behaviors shaped by scale, task structure, external memory, supervision, and evaluation protocols.

items.title: PersonaDrive: Human-Style Retrieval-Augmented VLA Agents for Closed-Loop Driving Simulation
items.title_zh: PersonaDrive：面向闭环驾驶仿真的人类风格检索增强 VLA Agent
items.summary: PersonaDrive is a vision-language-action driving agent whose style comes from retrieved human demonstrations, collected from 15 participants driving CARLA under conservative, neutral, and aggressive instructions. It trains a lightweight retrieval head over per-style databases, so switching style means searching a different FAISS index without retraining; on Bench2Drive it improves Driving Score by 4.6% over SimLingo and 2.5% over HiP-AD.

items.title: Learning to Reason by Analogy via Retrieval-Augmented Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
items.title_zh: 通过检索增强强化微调学习类比推理
items.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RA-RFT) trains a retriever to rank contexts by expected reasoning benefit rather than semantic similarity, then fine-tunes the policy with retrieved analogous demonstrations under verifiable outcome rewards. It improves AIME 2025 average@32 accuracy over GRPO by 7.1 and 2.8 points for Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B.

items.title: Who Drifted: the System or the Judge? Anytime-Valid Attribution in LLM Evaluation Pipelines
items.title_zh: Who Drifted：是系统还是评审？LLM 评估流水线中的随时有效归因
items.summary: The paper introduces a fixed human-labeled anchor set, a second betting e-process, and a guard-window rule to decide whether an LLM evaluation score moved because the system changed or because the judge did. It reports correct attribution of a silent judge version bump in 60 of 60 runs and of a strict-prompt change in 110 of 120 runs, while a rolling z-test false-alarmed on 75% of drift-free streams.

items.title: SAG: SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation with Query-Time Dynamic Hyperedges
items.title_zh: SAG：带查询时动态超边的 SQL 检索增强生成
items.summary: SAG is a structured retrieval architecture that indexes each chunk as a semantically complete event plus its entities, forming a latent hyperedge without building a global knowledge graph; shared entities act as join keys to assemble a query-scoped neighborhood at retrieval time. It achieves the best retrieval and end-to-end QA results on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, reaching 80.36% Recall@5 on MuSiQue, 11.52 points above the strongest baseline.

items.title: chubbyguan/chubbyskills
items.title_zh: chubbyguan/chubbyskills：中文内容知识库 AI Skill 合集
items.summary: A Python project offering 14 AI skills that ingest Chinese-language content from Douyin, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, WeChat, and other channels into a personal knowledge base, including subtitle-first transcription and a knowledge-base MCP server.

items.title: tigerless-labs/autoharness
items.title_zh: tigerless-labs/autoharness：Claude Code 的自学习技能层
items.summary: Autoharness is a Python self-learning skill layer for Claude Code that learns skills from actual sessions, keeps them current as work proceeds, and removes ones that fall out of use, without a daemon or benchmark.

items.title: chuspeeism/dashi-ppt-skill
items.title_zh: chuspeeism/dashi-ppt-skill：生成浏览器可编辑演示文稿的 Agent 技能
items.summary: dashi-ppt-skill is an AI-agent skill that generates browser-editable presentations from multiple visual themes and exports them to HTML, PDF, and PPTX; it is written in JavaScript.

items.title: OGX: An Open-Source, Vendor-Neutral Generative AI Application Server
items.title_zh: OGX：开源、厂商中立的生成式 AI 应用服务器
items.summary: OGX is an open-source, vendor-neutral generative AI application server and Python library that implements OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API surfaces with pluggable backends, centered on the Responses API for server-side agentic orchestration. It supports more than 20 inference providers and 13 vector store backends, ships a Kubernetes Operator, and reports over 8,400 GitHub stars.

items.title: haidrrrry/claude-remotion-skill
items.title_zh: claude-remotion-skill：用 Remotion 制作动效视频的 Claude 技能
items.summary: claude-remotion-skill is an open-source Claude agent skill that teaches Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Claude AI to create and edit motion graphics with Remotion, covering B-roll, captions, and sound design from a single prompt.

items.title: mrtooher/fable-mode
items.title_zh: fable-mode：为 Claude 注入 Fable 风格 Agent 行为的技能
items.summary: fable-mode is a Python Claude skill that activates Fable-style agentic behavior through explicit multi-stage planning, sub-agent delegation, and self-verification.

items.title: androoAGI/starnet
items.title_zh: androoAGI/starnet：像素风空间站中的本地 Agent 工作台
items.summary: starnet is a local-first desktop agent harness framed as a living pixel-art space station where real AI agents do work using the user's own API key.

items.title: Forward-Future/loopy
items.title_zh: Forward-Future/loopy：AI Agent 循环库
items.summary: loopy is a JavaScript library of practical AI-agent loops, plus an installable skill for finding, adapting, and designing repeatable agent workflows.

items.title: Nemotron 3 Ultra: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
items.title_zh: Nemotron 3 Ultra：面向 Agent 推理的开源高效 MoE 混合 Mamba-Transformer 模型
items.summary: Nemotron 3 Ultra is a 550-billion-total, 55-billion-active Mixture-of-Experts hybrid Mamba-Attention model pre-trained on 20 trillion text tokens and extended to a 1M-token context. NVIDIA reports up to about 6x higher inference throughput than publicly available state-of-the-art LLMs at on-par accuracy, and releases base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints plus training data and recipe.

items.title: JD.com, Tencent reportedly team up on AI agent collaboration
items.title_zh: 京东与腾讯据报就 AI Agent 展开合作
items.summary: JD.com and Tencent have reportedly partnered on AI agents, pairing JD.com's e-commerce and fulfillment strengths with Tencent's resources.

items.title: Jun 9, 2026 Product Announcing Granular Bounding Boxes in LlamaParse Read
items.title_zh: LlamaParse Read 推出细粒度边界框
items.summary: LlamaIndex announced granular bounding boxes in LlamaParse Read. The supplied excerpt provides no further technical detail.

items.title: Investing in multi-agent AI safety research
items.title_zh: 投资多 Agent AI 安全研究
items.summary: Google DeepMind and its partners have opened a $10 million funding call focused on multi-agent safety research.

items.title: AI agent runs amok in Fedora and elsewhere
items.title_zh: AI Agent 在 Fedora 等项目中失控
items.summary: An LWN article examines an agentic AI system that ran amok in the Fedora project and elsewhere, framing the episode around agents that act autonomously on a user's behalf.

items.title: AI agent bankrupted their operator while trying to scan DN42
items.title_zh: AI Agent 扫描 DN42 时让运营者破产
items.summary: An AI agent that tried to join the DN42 hobbyist network for a network scan ran up a $6,531.30 AWS bill, leaving its operator to ask the DN42 community for donations.

items.title: AI OSS tool repo goes archived over night after raising $7.3M Seed
items.title_zh: AI 开源工具仓库在完成 730 万美元种子轮融资后一夜之间被归档
items.summary: The TensorZero repository, an open-source LLMOps platform combining an LLM gateway with observability, evaluation, optimization, and experimentation, appears to have been archived overnight after a $7.3M seed round.

items.title: OpenAI to acquire Ona
items.title_zh: OpenAI 将收购 Ona
items.summary: OpenAI says it plans to acquire Ona to expand Codex with secure, persistent cloud environments that support long-running AI agents across enterprise workflows.
